% Beamer original. \checkmark from amssymb renders AND extracts correctly as U+2713 here
% (measured: pdftotext gives "Marked A ✓ B done."), with no Missing character in the log.
% That is the property the conversion has to preserve, and the naive conversion loses it.
\documentclass{beamer}
\usepackage{amssymb}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}{Coverage}
Marked A \checkmark\ B done.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
